cases.name: baseline
cases.reason: Unmodified actual source baseline, no product runtime.

cases.name: release
cases.reason: Actual triple view, DedicatedFlusher entry and continuation, scoped shared observation, release and resplit type-check.

cases.name: resplit
cases.reason: An active actual flusher prevents another mutable triple split.

cases.name: bound_move
cases.reason: The retained control owner outlives its actual flusher view.

cases.name: raw_requirement
cases.reason: A caller location cannot replace the authentic stage receipt.

cases.name: requirement_private
cases.reason: Only the WAL stage owner may construct an authentic receipt.

cases.name: durable_private
cases.reason: A prefix observation cannot manufacture the durability proof.

cases.name: durable_clone
cases.reason: The durability proof has no Clone authority.

cases.name: capture_clone
cases.reason: A coherent captured-image seal cannot be cloned.

cases.name: capture_private
cases.reason: Scalar stamp and receipt cannot manufacture the pool capture seal.

cases.name: finalize_private
cases.reason: External storage consumers cannot access retirement authority fields.

cases.name: raw_finalize
cases.reason: Conditional finalize requires the actual captured seal, not an observed FrameStamp.
